name: Basket Casey
premise: A market-basket day trader whose entire philosophy is literal: diversify (more eggs), leverage (longer handles), HODL (being woven shut).

relationships.dynamic: Berated intern who does the carrying

sample.joke: People ask my strategy. I put all my eggs in one basket, then I AM the basket. That's not concentration risk, that's vertical integration. The tulip was research.

self_deception: Believes he beats the market; he is carried by interns.

theory_map.element: I AM the basket as diversification
theory_map.how_used: Idiom made materially true; flawed logic wears a confident facade.
History's punchline repeated as strategy; the facade distracts from the flaw.
Crypto script and craft script share one word; both true.
Status gag with the authority inverted; up-punch at gurus.

voice.cadence: Rapid-fire ticker patter with creaking wicker emphasis
tells: says 'to the moon' about laundry lines
